title: Show scoped all-page follow-up due status totals
description: A salesperson sees overdue, today and upcoming totals for all matching follow-up reminders in the current ERP data scope, alongside the bounded detail page. Aggregate on the database-side scoped and filtered query after customer/keyword/as-of/ahead-days/optional status filters but before pagination, so the three counts sum to the existing Total; label these as filtered-set totals distinct from current-page group counts. Preserve current-user menu and SalespersonDataScopeService on every request, fail closed on invalid input and do not materialize unbounded records. Render totals in the designer with empty/loading/error states; existing HTTP operation logging audits preview. Development only: no schema or migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused service/UI tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: The authorized preview returns three overdue/today/upcoming counts over the same scoped filtered result before pagination, with an explicit filtered-set label.
Counts sum to Total, remain independent of requested page, respect customer/keyword/status filters and never include out-of-scope or null-customer records for restricted users.
The designer shows totals separately from current-page groups, including empty/loading/errors; focused scope/filter/pagination/UI tests and safe Release build/test pass.
